sources.title: textilelabs/Loom-Spark · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: First of the Loom models · Textile Labs Loom Spark is a ~7.6M parameter language model trained from scratch with an unusual objective: instead of memorizing facts, it was trained to know what it is — small, temporary, curious, honest about its limits, and skilled at one real superpower: forming clean search queries when connected to a tool-using agent harness.

sources.snippet: Run Loom-Spark-3 with FriendliAI inference. The first Loom built to search well, not just to search. Successor to Loom Spark 2.
